prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED DEEP VIOLET flat color field — think #5B3F92,
the color of concealment, unspoken history, and suppressed memory on a
semantic map. The hue must read as VIOLET, not black, not slate, not
ocean blue. Clearly distinct from yoke maroon and cave-pocket indigo.
Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this one deep-violet
color corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border, NO vignette, NO
centered composition, NO symbols, NO caves, NO figures, NO script. Only
the faintest paint-texture variation within the same violet hue. A
semantic terrain region-fill swatch, not an illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Saturated deep violet flat wash in bold comic-map ink, pure solid terrain fill of vivid purple-violet hue, edge-to-edge across the entire square tile with faint painterly texture variation within the same violet register.

subjects.description: Uniform saturated deep violet color field, full 1024x1024 fill, subtle paint-stroke texture within the same hue, no motifs, no figures
Barely perceptible brushstroke grain rippling through the violet field, same hue throughout, tonal micro-variation only
